lastCompletedStory.title: Attach the reviewer artifact-of-record to the PR at ship (gh pr comment)

nextStoryContext: US-006 added an artifact-of-record ship step to both .claude/commands/cam-ship.md and templates/commands/cam-ship.md. The step is placed after the PR body template block and before the **Merge mode** subsection, ensuring it runs on both immediate and ci-gated merge modes. It captures PR_NUMBER via 'gh pr view --json number --jq .number', then guards on the presence of scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt, prepends a '**artifact-of-record**' label header into a tmp file, and posts via 'gh pr comment $PR_NUMBER --body-file /tmp/cam-artifact-comment.txt || true' (best-effort: failure does not abort ship). The artifact is never committed to the repo (gitignored). src/vendor/_generated.ts was regenerated. All file-assert oracles pass.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: gh pr comment accepts --body-file (-F) for reading body from a file; PR number is a positional arg. Usage 'gh pr comment "$PR_NUMBER" --body-file <file>' matches the documented API.
